result.stdout:
Usage: easytdd-mcp [--solution <path>]

Run the EasyTdd MCP server over standard input/output.
Without --solution, use the load_solution MCP tool after connecting.

  --solution <path>  Load a .sln file in the background at startup.
  --help, -h         Show this help and exit.
  --version          Show the installed MCP version and exit.
